note: Two FLUX passes were superseded before the shipped set. The raws and their recorded seeds are kept on disk as the record of what was rejected and why - the autumn set (SOU-274) keeps its rejected pass the same way, and both are what makes a later review able to tell a re-roll from a first pass.

superseded.discarded_before: assemble (nothing derived from it ever reached the served tree)
superseded.why: Those three seeds are exactly the seeds the AUTUMN set shipped: autumn's base is 27400 and its accepted pass used --seed-shift 100, so autumn's recorded seeds are 27528/27535/27542. A spring pass on the same numbers is a re-used generation for a different season, which is a defect a reviewer should not have to catch. Regenerated with --seed-shift 1000 (base 27500 per the ticket-number convention, matching summer's 27600).

The gate failed the ticket's 'dark trunks' clause: only 66% of the sapling's trunk band was below the luminance floor (99%+ on the other two trees). Measured cause: stray light grey/blue pixels (stone_light, stone_warm, steel_100) beside the trunk where the FLUX pass drew noise; a magnified look confirmed the trunk itself is correctly dark brown and the light pixels are not attached to it. Re-rolled rather than explained away, because a stray light pixel cluster in a 32x64 sprite is a visible speck at 1x.
